name: Feketeerdő (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with the municipal arms of Feketeerdő: a white shield with a green tree, within a green wreath, above a red scroll inscribed FEKETEERDŐ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Feketeerdő arms with wreath and scroll
